name: Pacifica
source: A girl of many talents who can wear the hat of a detective, that of a teacher, or even that of a craftswoman. She's in charge of fixing all sorts of troublesome situations around town. She sounds like one extremely influential individual but, around Sayoko, she behaves like any other normal girl.
